cards.title: This is Money 24
cards.text: It turns a trade idea into a full plan: the entry, the exits, the stop and the odds. Then it trades the plan on paper. It is a work in progress and not active yet.

cards.title: A snapshot
cards.text: Everything here was recorded on {when}, from Money 24's own runner and public sources. Nothing is live, and nothing you do here can place an order.
cards.textPending: Everything here was recorded earlier, from Money 24's own runner and public sources. Nothing is live, and nothing you do here can place an order.

cards.title: Four pages
cards.text: Plays, Trading, Markets and News are along the top. Start on Plays: pick one and drag its stake dial.

blurbs.text: The fine print, on the move. Click the strip to read all of it.
Demo means recorded. On your own machine this turns green and says Live.
Paste a Robinhood or Webull link, or type AAL 12.5P 11/20. On your own machine it becomes a paper trade at once.
Every play, with what has to happen for it to pay. Pick one.
The odds the whole play ends in profit at the stake on the dial.
Drag the stake. Every number on the play follows it.
Callouts come in here. The demo only reads; your own runner paper trades them.
Who the runner listens to: callers, option flow, news and leaderboards.
Six symbols were recorded. Try SPY or BTC-USD.
One day to all time. The chart redraws from the recording.
News, Calendar and Network. The calendar holds earnings, auctions and economic releases.
